_meta.source: DraftSharks NFL Coaching Changes 2026 (offense); FantasySixPack AFC+NFC IDP (Steve Hungarter); NYT Athletic DC overview (Mike Jones)
_meta.note: Real, sourced 2026 coaching changes + scheme tendencies. Do not fabricate; only teams listed here changed play-caller/scheme for 2026. '_defense' holds new-DC scheme + IDP/DST beneficiaries.

_defense._src: FantasySixPack AFC (fantasysixpack.net/2026-afc-coaching-changes-idp-football) + NFC (fantasysixpack.net/2026-nfc-coaching-changes-idp-impact); NYT Athletic 2026 DC overview

DAL.scheme: Vic Fangio tree: hybrid 3-4/3-3-5, two-high shells, disguise

idp.Jalen Thompson: Fangio two-high shell boosts safety production across the field
idp.DaRon Bland: instinctive DB can still make plays in disguise-heavy scheme

DAL.note: Safety-friendly Fangio shell; LB production roughly steady, CBs fewer INT chances.

GB.scheme: Fangio tree: 3-4 base, heavy quarters, zone over man, keep everything in front

idp.Micah Parsons: thrives on isolation from simulated-pressure looks (once back from surgery)
idp.Xavier McKinney: safety production elevated in two-high shells

GB.note: Zone-heavy funnels tackles to LBs + safeties; edge is talent-driven.

NYG.scheme: Ravens-rooted, bully mentality, zone-heavy Cover 3/4/match, downhill LBs

idp.Bobby Okereke: starting off-ball LBs are the most valuable assets — bone-crushing hits over the middle
idp.Brian Burns: wins matchups, though production spreads out in team-oriented zone
idp.Abdul Carter: edge wins matchups in aggressive front

NYG.note: Both LB spots critical; zone spreads production but LB tackle volume is prime.

SF.scheme: 'Tite' front, 4-3 shifting to 3-4, clogs interior run, funnels outside

idp.Fred Warner: central figure controlling run flow + cleaning up perimeter plays — elite LB tackle floor
idp.Nick Bosa: isolated one-on-one pass-rush chances from tight interior alignment
idp.Mykel Williams: flexible DL gets pressure chances sliding inside on passing downs

SF.note: Tite front = strong IDP value for edges, disruptive DTs, and steady LB tackles.

WAS.scheme: Brian Flores tree: 4-2-5 nickel, zone (Cover 2/4/quarters), simulated pressures

idp.Bobby Wagner: zone spacing + underneath responsibility supports strong LB tackle production
idp.Odafe Oweh: sleeper — expanded role, strong underlying efficiency, buy-low window
idp.Leo Chenal: sleeper — flashed efficiency, positioned for expanded 2026 role
idp.Nick Cross: safety stays active in run support + coverage reads

WAS.note: Structured balanced D; LB tackle floors + Oweh/Chenal buy-low IDP sleepers.

BAL.scheme: Fast/aggressive hybrid 3-4, heavy rotation, nickel/dime, disrupt QB

idp.Roquan Smith: elite every-down LB anchor — top IDP pick
idp.Kyle Hamilton: elite safety anchor — top IDP pick
idp.Trey Hendrickson: proven edge (back-to-back 17-sack seasons) in pressure-first scheme
idp.Nnamdi Madubuike: led all DTs in sacks in 2023 if healthy

BAL.note: Overhauled pass rush + pressure emphasis; multiple every-down IDP producers.

idp.Terrel Bernard: strong bounce-back — speed-based game, healthy season + depressed ADP = value
idp.Bradley Chubb: opposite-edge role in blitz-heavy front (health is the question)

BUF.note: 3-4 switch may take time to settle; Bernard is the bounce-back IDP value.

idp.Myles Garrett: reigning DPOY — elite edge regardless of scheme
idp.Carson Schwesinger: DROY, competent every-down LB in new nickel scheme

CLE.note: Big-nickel prioritizes hybrids; Garrett + Schwesinger are the IDP anchors.

idp.Derwin James: effective every-down safety in stable scheme
idp.Tuli Tuipulotu: 13 sacks last year, Pro Bowl edge

LAC.note: Scheme continuity = IDP certainty; James + the edge trio are reliable.

LV.scheme: Switch to 3-4, more flexibility/less predictability, aggressive

idp.Maxx Crosby: moves to 3-4 OLB — more pass-rush flexibility, could unlock new version
idp.Tyree Wilson: 4i-technique fits his length/power better than pure edge
idp.Quay Walker: target — value to whoever gets green-dot role

LV.note: 3-4 overhaul; Crosby flexibility + Walker/Dean green-dot LB battle.

NYJ.scheme: Multiple fronts, heavy disguise, man-coverage lean, ~70% nickel

idp.Jamien Sherwood: in for a volume tackle year

NYJ.note: Man-heavy multiple front; Sherwood is the volume LB play.

TEN.scheme: 4-3 under, Cover 3 zone, Wide-9 edges, light boxes

idp.Cedric Gray: huge year expected — Saleh grooms elite LBs; was LB6 in tackles + 92.7 run-D grade
idp.Anthony Hill: rookie, 17 career sacks off edge — adapts quickly

TEN.note: Saleh 4-3 Cover 3; Cedric Gray is the marquee IDP breakout.

PIT.scheme: Multiple 4-3/3-4 hybrid, run-defense emphasis, fast turnarounds

idp.Patrick Queen: athletic ILB — Graham needs more discipline/execution but tone-setter upside
idp.Payton Wilson: athletic ILB who can make plays all over

PIT.note: Hybrid run-focused D; Queen + Wilson are the LB tone-setters to watch.

MIA.scheme: 4-3 with 4-2-5 hybrid base, LB-friendly (Duggan ex-LB coach)
MIA.note: LB-friendly rebuild; thin on proven talent, more relevant for 2027 rookies.

NE.note: Limited scheme specifics; physical identity, 'more of the same'.

ARI.scheme: McVay tree: pre-snap motion + play-action, flexible personnel

beneficiaries.Trey McBride: Petzing gone but McVay-tree still funnels TE targets; motion/PA scheme keeps him a target hog

ARI.note: More run-leaning than 2025's pass-heavy Petzing offense; efficiency upside.

beneficiaries.Bijan Robinson: Zone-heavy design fits his 75% career zone runs; balanced offense = 20+ weekly touches, top-5 pick

ATL.note: Run-focused, RB-friendly. Unsettled Tua/Penix QB keeps run game central.

BAL.scheme: Ben Johnson tree: explosive, high-pace, creative

beneficiaries.Lamar Jackson: New system Lamar calls 'mind-blowing'; Bears ranked 7th explosive pass rate — rebound upside
beneficiaries.Derrick Henry: Bears were 2nd in explosive run rate; scheme + age-defying form keeps him RB1

BAL.note: Explosive scheme upgrade for both stars.

BUF.scheme: Run-lean, controlled pace, elite per-play efficiency

beneficiaries.Josh Allen: Continuity at play-caller; was fantasy QB1 last year
beneficiaries.James Cook: RB6 last year; receiving usage may rise under Carmichael
beneficiaries.DJ Moore: Big setup upgrade as lead WR; commanded 23-26% target share under Brady before

BUF.note: Same play-caller (Brady) — continuity, whole offense is a fantasy winner.

CHI.note: Johnson still calls plays — no regression expected from OC change.

CLE.scheme: Flexible; run-focused build w/ elite run-game coordinator

beneficiaries.Quinshon Judkins: Shaky QB battle pushes Cleveland to the run; Monken praised his skill set + power

CLE.note: QB uncertainty (Watson/Sanders) favors the run game.

DEN.scheme: Sean Payton system, quick passing game

beneficiaries.Jaylen Waddle: Traded in; fits quick catch-and-run scheme, 5.0 career YAC/rec

DEN.note: Same Payton philosophy; Webb calls it but 'same offense'.

DET.scheme: Explosive zone run design (ARI led/2nd explosive run rate)

beneficiaries.Jahmyr Gibbs: Lightest career carry competition + Petzing's explosive run design; explosive-run rebound

DET.note: Won't drastically change from Campbell; Gibbs gets proven run scheme.

KC.scheme: Reid offense; Bieniemy boosts explosive run game

beneficiaries.Kenneth Walker: Bieniemy's explosive-run history (CHI 3rd, WAS 4th) fits Walker's big-play talent

KC.note: Bieniemy returns as OC; biggest impact is the run game.

LAC.scheme: Shanahan-tree: quick game, YAC, explosive zone run

beneficiaries.Justin Herbert: McDaniel quickening his footwork/release; YAC scheme (MIA 2nd in YAC share)
beneficiaries.Ladd McConkey: 47% of career targets 0-9 yards — perfect McDaniel quick-game fit
beneficiaries.Omarion Hampton: McDaniel's elite run-game history (made Achane explosive); top-10 RB case if lead role

LAC.note: Three clear beneficiaries in McDaniel's efficient, YAC-heavy scheme.

LV.scheme: Under-center, play-action, designed movement; RB1/TE1 volume

beneficiaries.Ashton Jeanty: Could be used like McCaffrey under Kubiak; better O-line + QB (monitor Aug 23 ankle)
beneficiaries.Brock Bowers: Kubiak called him a 'football robot'; his top pass-catchers (JJ, JSN) drew 28-34% target shares

LV.note: Jeanty CMC-usage upside; Bowers is the clear centerpiece / TE1.

beneficiaries.De'Von Achane: 79.6% career zone carries — no adjustment needed in Slowik's zone scheme

MIA.note: Big shift to run-heavy (52.4%); uncertain fantasy winners with Willis at QB.

NYG.scheme: West Coast, 11-personnel; run signals w/ Greg Roman added

beneficiaries.Cam Skattebo: Harbaugh called him 'top-tier back'; FB + Greg Roman (10 top-10 rush finishes) added — clear top back

NYG.note: Nagy history unsettling, but heavy run-game signals point to Skattebo.

beneficiaries.Breece Hall: Reich says offense starts with run game; fits Geno + Hall's new contract

risk.Saquon Barkley: New wide-zone install + O-line questions; YBC dropped 2.64->1.36 in 2025 behind hurt line — wild card
risk.Jalen Hurts: Mannion untested play-caller; A.J. Brown gone — bigger offensive wild card

PHI.note: 5th OC since 2021; A.J. Brown gone — one of the league's bigger wild cards.

PIT.scheme: West Coast timing, willing to push pace, pass-lean

risk.Aaron Rodgers: Familiar McCarthy offense helps him, but finished QB26 last year — Superflex-only value

PIT.note: Pass-lean, up-tempo; limited fantasy standouts outside Superflex QB.

LAR.note: McVay still calls plays; all key pieces return (Stafford QB2, Puka WR1, Kyren RB9) — smooth continuity, no change.

SEA.scheme: Shanahan-tree (ex-SF); similar to Kubiak's Super Bowl offense

beneficiaries.Rashid Shaheed: Sources: 'major spring', taking more short/intermediate routes; less volatile, upside
beneficiaries.Jaxon Smith-Njigba: Led NFL at 33.9% target share; could repeat, though slight target redistribution possible

SEA.note: Profiles similarly to Kubiak's SB offense; Shaheed sneaky winner.

TB.scheme: McVay tree: balance, above-avg pace, heavy pre-snap motion

beneficiaries.Emeka Egbuka: Retained-promise WR corps w/ Mayfield who trusts Robinson; motion-heavy scheme
beneficiaries.Baker Mayfield: Trusts Robinson from LA; demands-excellence OC, molds scheme to personnel

risk.Mike Evans: Must adjust — note: on other rosters Evans is aging in a reshaped WR room

TB.note: Motion-heavy McVay-tree; Mayfield-Robinson trust is real.

beneficiaries.Cam Ward: Mobility + arm talent to grow under Daboll (fueled Allen breakout); stronger 2026 WR help
beneficiaries.Wan'Dale Robinson: 4 yrs w/ Daboll, drew 140 targets each of last 2 years; $38M guaranteed locks a key role

TEN.note: Daboll's Allen/Jones history; Wan'Dale reunion is the fantasy tell.

WAS.scheme: More under-center + play-action; move McLaurin around formation

beneficiaries.Terry McLaurin: Blough moving him around formation for better matchups; targeted '10 targets a game' + explosives

WAS.note: McLaurin is the obvious beneficiary of varied alignment usage.
